visual_elements.description: Input vector box (a1,a2)^T , (b1,b2)^T, pale cream fill ~#FFFDE7, gray stroke #808080
Normal Model box, blue stroke #0000FF white fill, red heading, inner light-cyan rounded box #DFF3F7 stroke #2E9BB5 holding row x column product
Map label strip, pale yellow fill ~#FFFFCC, blue italic bold text
Vectors Mapping box, red stroke #FF0000, red bold heading, 'a , b => u , v'
Beige '[a^T b]^2' label above Vectors Mapping
Complexity notes, lavender fill ~#E9D6F5, purple stroke/text #7030A0, three lines 'Higher / Computational / Complexity !!!'
3-D mapped vectors box, lavender fill ~#F3EAFB, purple stroke #7030A0, a-vector maroon #8B0000, b-vector blue #0000FF
Kernelized Model box, green stroke #00B050 white fill, red heading, inner light-green rounded box #E2EFDA stroke #00B050 holding 3-term row x column product

typography_notes: Sans-serif Calibri/Arial-like. Title ~30pt bold red left-of-centre. 'Example-1' ~14pt bold blue. Badge '21' ~14pt black. Model headings ~12-13pt bold red. Sub-labels ~11pt black. Map strip ~13pt bold italic blue. Complexity notes ~10pt bold purple centered three lines. Vector math ~11-12pt with sub/superscripts.
recreation_brief:
1. Canvas: 13.33x7.5in, white background #FFFFFF. Draw outer red frame rectangle at normalized [0.065,0.078,0.958,0.944], stroke #C00000 1.5pt, no fill.
2. Draw dashed blue rounded box at [0.073,0.102,0.193,0.170], white fill #FFFFFF, dashed stroke #0000FF; text 'Example-1' ~14pt bold #0000FF centered.
3. Place title text 'Quadratic Kernel' in the header row left-of-centre between the 'Example-1' badge and the maroon equation, color #C00000, bold ~30pt sans-serif.
4. Place maroon text '[a^T b]^2' at [0.609,0.102,0.729,0.148], color #7B1B1B, bold ~14pt.
5. Draw yellow circle at [0.863,0.093,0.917,0.178], fill #FFFF00, no stroke; text '21' #000000 ~14pt bold centered.
6. Draw upper input vector box at [0.081,0.259,0.175,0.367], fill #FFFDE7, stroke #808080; text '(a1, a2)^T , (b1, b2)^T' #000000 ~11pt centered.
7. Draw long red block arrow at [0.193,0.296,0.547,0.333], fill #FF0000, pointing right.
8. Draw 'Normal Model' outer rectangle at [0.542,0.200,0.880,0.441], white fill, stroke #0000FF; heading 'Normal Model' #C00000 bold ~12-13pt at top.
9. Inside Normal Model, draw light-cyan rounded box at [0.651,0.306,0.776,0.417], fill #DFF3F7, stroke #2E9BB5; text 'Calculate a^T b' #000000 ~11pt and equation '(a1  a2) (b1 ; b2)' #000000 ~11pt.
10. Draw short red exit arrow at [0.885,0.296,0.932,0.333], fill #FF0000, pointing right.
11. Draw pale-yellow strip at [0.099,0.430,0.490,0.485], fill #FFFFCC; text 'Map Input data from 2-D to 3-D' #0000FF bold italic ~13pt centered.
12. Draw lower input vector box at [0.081,0.648,0.175,0.769], fill #FFFDE7, stroke #808080; text '(a1, a2)^T , (b1, b2)^T' #000000 ~11pt centered.
13. Draw small red arrow at [0.182,0.689,0.224,0.726], fill #FF0000, pointing right.
14. Draw 'Vectors Mapping' rectangle at [0.214,0.657,0.365,0.769], white fill, stroke #FF0000; heading 'Vectors Mapping' #FF0000 bold ~12-13pt, text 'a , b => u , v' #000000 ~11pt.
15. Draw beige label '[a^T b]^2' at [0.250,0.578,0.349,0.639], fill #F5E6C8; text '[a^T b]^2' #000000 ~11pt centered.
16. Draw purple complexity note at [0.234,0.787,0.354,0.880], fill #E9D6F5, stroke #7030A0; text 'Higher / Computational / Complexity !!!' #7030A0 bold ~10pt centered on three lines.
17. Draw red arrow at [0.370,0.689,0.411,0.726], fill #FF0000, pointing right.
18. Draw 3-D mapped vectors box at [0.411,0.574,0.562,0.852], fill #F3EAFB, stroke #7030A0; text '(a1^2, a2^2, sqrt(2) a1 a2)^T , (b1^2, b2^2, sqrt(2) b1 b2)^T' with a-vector #8B0000 and b-vector #0000FF ~11pt.
19. Draw red arrow at [0.568,0.689,0.604,0.726], fill #FF0000, pointing right.
20. Draw 'Kernelized Model' outer rectangle at [0.578,0.509,0.875,0.926], white fill, stroke #00B050; heading 'Kernelized Model' #C00000 bold ~12-13pt at top.
21. Inside Kernelized Model, draw light-green rounded box at [0.609,0.639,0.823,0.843], fill #E2EFDA, stroke #00B050; text 'Calculate u^T v' #000000 ~11pt and equation '(a1^2  a2^2  sqrt(2) a1 a2) (b1^2 ; b2^2 ; sqrt(2) b1 b2)' #000000 ~11pt.
22. Draw purple complexity note at [0.609,0.778,0.734,0.880], fill #E9D6F5, stroke #7030A0; text 'Higher / Computational / Complexity !!!' #7030A0 bold ~10pt centered on three lines.
23. Draw red exit arrow at [0.880,0.689,0.927,0.726], fill #FF0000, pointing right.
24. Format all vector/equation constructs in Professional Format (stacked column vectors in parentheses, superscripts).
